events.event_name: Bobbi Brown — The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, 9th Avenue between 14th and 15th Street, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day Bobbi Brown newsstand activation for Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ with sampling, refreshments, scratch-off giveaways and a photo moment.
events.what_is_free: A VEFB+ sample, grapefruit Spindrift, mini croissant and scratch-off giveaway opportunity while supplies last; the first 100 guests are advertised to receive a deluxe-size sample.
events.caveats: The host Eventbrite listing is free, but current public listings also describe the activation as open to the public. Samples, refreshments and prizes are while supplies last. Do not imply the deluxe sample is available after the first 100 guests.
events.practical_notes: Thursday Sept. 17, noon–6 PM at Chelsea Triangle in the Meatpacking District.

events.event_name: Happy Camp3r — The Sweetest Stop in NYC
events.what_it_is: Happy Camp3r's first NYC pop-up, featuring new apparel, sweet treats, photo moments, exclusive experiences and surprises throughout the weekend.
events.what_is_free: Public admission is free; current listings advertise sweet treats and surprises, but do not establish a guaranteed free item for every visitor.
events.caveats: Parasol Projects confirms the Sept. 14–20 tenancy at 251 Elizabeth Street; current event listings identify the public activation hours as Sept. 18–20, 10 AM–6 PM. Treat advertised treats/surprises as availability-dependent rather than guaranteed freebies.
events.practical_notes: Public activation Friday Sept. 18 through Sunday Sept. 20, 10 AM–6 PM daily at 251 Elizabeth Street.

events.what_it_is: DedCool's first café-and-retail pop-up, celebrating the Mocha Magic fragrance with café drinks, fragrance sampling, merchandise and gifts.
events.what_is_free: Fragrance sampling is available, and the first 50 people in line each day receive a special gift; other gifts may require purchase.
events.caveats: Current listings advertise free RSVP and a special gift only for the first 50 guests each day. Gifts with purchase are separate. The exact direct RSVP destination was not independently recovered, so the main event source is provided rather than inventing a registration URL.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18–20, 9 AM–6 PM daily at 262 Mott Street. Arrive early for the first-50 gift.

events.event_name: Cj Hendry's Flower Market at Rockefeller Center
events.address: Center Plaza, 30 Rockefeller Plaza, New York, NY 10112
events.what_it_is: Cj Hendry's four-day Flower Market installation at Center Plaza, featuring a new collection of plush flowers modeled on flowers native to New York City.
events.what_is_free: Entry is free and every guest receives one flower free. Additional flowers cost $5 each.
events.caveats: Hours are explicitly subject to change based on flower availability. General entry is free; a separate paid Flower Market Express / Top of the Rock option provides priority entry and should not be confused with ordinary admission.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 24: 1–8 PM. Sept. 25–27: 10 AM–8 PM. Center Plaza at Rockefeller Center. One free flower per guest; additional flowers $5.
